test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "discomfort."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"discomfort" **in the blank is to describe the feeling that some individuals experience when wearing earrings. (रिक्त स्थान में **"discomfort"** का उपयोग करने का कारण उस भावना का वर्णन करना है जो कुछ व्यक्तियों को बालियां पहनते समय अनुभव होती है।)
 
• **"Discomfort" **conveys a sense of unease, pain, or irritation, suggesting that for some people, the unpleasant sensation is significant enough to deter them from wearing earrings altogether.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct paragraph: 

Metal allergies can begin to act up within__ minutes of putting earrings in your ears. Some people can go a few hours before having to __take__ the earrings out, but some can barely stand the __**discomfort**__ enough to bother putting earrings in at all. This can be discouraging for those of us ______ (4) ______ love to wear earrings, but fortunately hypoallergenic jewellery for ______ (5) ______ ears exists! 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Burn: **damage or an injury caused by fire or heat. (आग या ताप से हुई क्षति**)**
 
• **Bomb: **a container that is filled with material that will explode when it is thrown or dropped, or when a device inside it makes it explode. (बम, गोला, विस्‍फोटक पदार्थ से भरा पात्र)
 
• **Knife: **a sharp flat piece of metal (a blade) with a handle. A knife is used for cutting things or as a weapon. (चाक़ू, छुरी, छुरा)
